enquiryNotice.point2: Customers may submit an enquiry through this website. If the customer agrees, the enquiry may be converted into an order based on their requirements and interest, subject to all applicable laws, rules, and regulations.
enquiryNotice.point3: Rajalakshmi Fireworks does not provide an instant online purchase or checkout facility. Any order confirmation and payment process will be handled only after customer confirmation and in accordance with applicable legal requirements.
enquiryNotice.point4: Rajalakshmi Fireworks strictly follows all applicable protocols and statutory requirements under the relevant laws and regulations, including the Explosives Act. All parcels are dispatched only through registered and legally authorized transport service providers.
enquiryNotice.point5: By clicking 'I Understand & Proceed', you acknowledge that you are submitting a price & availability enquiry, not placing an instant online commercial order.
